description: Content approval workflow (step-02-approve) blocked by Slack API tunnel failure. read.py fails with 'Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden' when attempting to read thread replies from #content. 3 pending drafts cannot be processed for approval/rejection/regeneration.
correction: The workflow correctly identified the blocking condition and halted execution. No correction needed at the agent level. This is an infrastructure/auth issue requiring manual intervention on the Slack bot token or network tunnel configuration.
systemic_fix: Add a pre-flight health check to the content pipeline that validates Slack API connectivity before attempting scheduled approval runs. If unreachable, bypass approval step and notify David immediately rather than silently blocking.
